Signatures on the menu

Familiar brunch plates, lifted with Asian-fusion flavour. The full menu and today's prices are at the cafe.

Big Breakfast

A generous, classic breakfast plate — the biggest way to start a West End morning.

Crab Omelette

One of the kitchen's crab signatures, alongside the cafe's soft-shell crab dishes.

Corn Fritter Stack
